Label: annotationsPerItem
Comment: Number of human labels per dataset item, if applicable.

Label: annotatorDemographics
Comment: List of demographics specifications about the annotators, if applicable.

Label: dataAnnotationAnalysis
Comment: Considerations related to the process of converting the "raw" annotations into the labels that are ultimately packaged in a dataset - Uncertainty or disagreement between annotations on each instance as a signal in the dataset, analysis of systematic disagreements between annotators of different socio demographic group,  how the final dataset annotations will relate to individual annotator responses.

Label: dataAnnotationPlatform
Comment: Platform, tool, or library used to collect annotations by human annotators, if applicable.

Label: dataAnnotationProtocol
Comment: Description of annotations (labels, ratings) produced, including how these were created or authored - Annotation Workforce Type, Annotation Characteristic(s), Annotation Description(s), Annotation Task(s), Annotation Distribution(s).

Label: dataBiases
Comment: Description of biases in dataset, if applicable.

Label: dataCollection
Comment: Description of the data collection process.

Label: dataCollectionMissingData
Comment: Description of missing data in structured/unstructured form.

Label: dataCollectionRawData
Comment: Description of the raw data i.e. source of the data.

Label: dataCollectionTimeframe
Comment: Timeframe in terms of start and end date of the collection process, that it described as a DateTime indicating a time period in ISO 8601 time interval format. For example, a collection time frame ranging from 2020 - 2022 can be indicated in ISO 8601 interval format via "2020/2022".

Label: dataCollectionType
Comment: Define the data collection type. Recommended values: Surveys, Secondary Data analysis, Physical data collection, Direct measurement, Document analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Experiments, Web Scraping, Web API, Focus groups, Self-reporting, Customer feedback data, User-generated content data, Passive Data Collection, Others.

Label: dataImputationProtocol
Comment: Description of data imputation process, if applicable.

Label: dataLimitations
Comment: Known limitations - Data generalization limits (e.g related to data distribution, data quality issues, or data sources) and on-recommended uses, if applicable.

Label: dataManipulationProtocol
Comment: Description of data manipulation process, if applicable.

Label: dataPreprocessingProtocol
Comment: Description of the steps that were required to bring collected data to a state that can be processed by an ML model/algorithm, e.g. filtering out incomplete entries etc, if applicable.

Label: dataReleaseMaintenancePlan
Comment: Versioning information in terms of the updating timeframe, the maintainers, and the deprecation policies.

Label: dataSocialImpact
Comment: Discussion of social impact, if applicable.

Label: dataUseCases
Comment: Dataset Use(s) - Training, Testing, Validation, Development or Production Use, Fine Tuning, Others (please specify), Usage Guidelines. Recommended uses.

Label: machineAnnotationTools
Comment: List of software used for data annotation (e.g., concept extraction, NER, and additional characteristics of the tools used for annotation to allow for replication or extension).

Label: personalSensitiveInformation
Comment: Sensitive Human Attribute(s)- Gender, Socio-economic status, Geography, Language, Age, Culture, Experience or Seniority, Others (please specify), if applicable.

Label: annotation
Comment: One or more data-level annotations that apply to the entire record or field.

Label: arrayShape
Comment: Shape of the data tensor/array associated with a field (e.g., [height, width, bands] for imagery).

Label: citeAs
Comment: How to cite this dataset. Ideally, citations should be expressed using the bibtex format. Note that this is different from schema.org/citation, which is used to make a citation to another publication from this dataset.

Label: column
Comment: In case the data source is tabular, the id of a column to extract.

Label: containedIn
Comment: Another FileObject, FileSet or DataSource that this one is contained in, e.g., in the case of a file extracted from an archive. When this property is present, the contentUrl is evaluated as a relative path within the container object.

Label: content
Comment: What to extract from the data source content, e.g., lines.

Label: data
Comment: One or more inlined records that constitute the data of the RecordSet, typically used for small enumeration values.

Label: dataType
Comment: The data type of the field, identified by the URI of the corresponding class. It could be either an atomic type (e.g, sc:Integer) or a semantic type (e.g., sc:GeoLocation).

Label: equivalentProperty
Comment: A property that is equivalent to this Field. Used in the case a dataType is specified on the RecordSet to map specific fields to specific properties associated with that dataType.

Label: examples
Comment: One more inlined records provided as example content of the RecordSet.

Label: excludes
Comment: A glob pattern that specifies the files to exclude. The pattern is evaluated from the root of the containedIn contents, after the includes patterns have been evaluated.

Label: extract
Comment: The extraction method from the provided source.

Label: field
Comment: A data element that appears in the records of the RecordSet (e.g., one column of a table).

Label: fileObject
Comment: The id of a FileObject that is the source of the data.

Label: fileProperty
Comment: The file property to extract from the data source metadata, e.g., the filename.

Label: fileSet
Comment: The id of a FileSet that is the source of the data.

Label: format
Comment: A format to parse the values of the data from text, e.g., a date format or number format.

Label: bandConfiguration
Comment: Configuration describing raster band organization and semantics for a dataset or asset (e.g., band ordering and names).

Label: bandNamesList
Comment: Ordered list of band names corresponding to the band stack described by geocr:bandConfiguration.

Label: bandwidth
Comment: Spectral bandwidth for a geocr:SpectralBand entry (typically in geocr:spectralBandMetadata), expressed as a QuantitativeValue.

Label: centerWavelength
Comment: Center wavelength for a geocr:SpectralBand entry (typically in geocr:spectralBandMetadata), expressed as a QuantitativeValue.

Label: channelList
Comment: List of wavelength channels (e.g., 171Å, 193Å) used within geocr:MultiWavelengthConfiguration.

Label: coordinateReferenceSystem
Comment: Coordinate reference system (CRS) identifier (e.g., EPSG code) used to interpret spatial data in the dataset.

Label: instrument
Comment: Instrument identifier used within geocr:SolarInstrumentCharacteristics (for later mapping to SPASE).

Label: multiWavelengthConfiguration
Comment: Composite property to group multi-wavelength configuration information for Space Weather / heliophysics datasets; intended to map to SPASE constructs.

Label: observatory
Comment: Observatory/platform identifier used within geocr:SolarInstrumentCharacteristics (for later mapping to SPASE).

Label: recordEndpoint
Comment: A service endpoint that provides programmatic access to the dataset's metadata records (e.g., listing, paging, and filtering records).

Label: samplingStrategy
Comment: Description of how samples were selected or constructed (e.g., chip/windowing strategy, filtering criteria) to support reproducibility and interpretation.

Label: solarInstrumentCharacteristics
Comment: Composite property to group solar/heliophysics instrument characteristics for Space Weather datasets; intended to map to SPASE constructs.

Label: spatialBias
Comment: Description of spatial representativeness limitations (e.g., geographic concentration, under-sampled regions/biomes) that may affect model generalization and evaluation.

Label: spatialIndex
Comment: Precomputed spatial index token(s) (e.g., DGGS cell ID or geohash-like key) to accelerate coarse spatial filtering and discovery at scale.

Label: spatialResolution
Comment: Nominal spatial resolution for the dataset or collection (e.g., '30m' or a QuantitativeValue with units). May be provided at dataset level or at record/collection level when resolution varies.

Label: spectralBandMetadata
Comment: Per-band spectral metadata for EO imagery (e.g., center wavelength, bandwidth), represented as one or more geocr:SpectralBand entries.

Label: temporalResolution
Comment: Temporal cadence of the dataset or collection (e.g., 1 month), typically expressed as a QuantitativeValue (value + unit), or as text. May be provided at dataset level or at record/collection level when cadence varies.

Label: timeSeriesIndex
Comment: Identifies the record-level field used to order/index observations in a time series (e.g., a timestamp field in a RecordSet).

Label: totalBands
Comment: Total number of bands for an asset or dataset described by geocr:bandConfiguration.

Label: includes
Comment: A glob pattern that specifies the files to include, e.g., ".jpg", "/foo/pic*.jpg". The pattern is evaluated from the root of the containedIn contents.

Label: isLiveDataset
Comment: Indicates that the dataset is continuously updated instead of being versioned.

Label: jsonPath
Comment: In case the data source is JSON data, a path expression to extract a subset of the data.

Label: key
Comment: One or more fields whose values uniquely identify each record in the RecordSet. (See example below.)

Label: md5
Comment: The MD5 hash of the file.

Label: parentField
Comment: A special case of SubField that should be hidden because it references a Field that already appears in the RecordSet.

Label: readLines
Comment: Read the content of the file line by line.

Label: recordSet
Comment: The id of a RecordSet that is the source of the data.

Label: references
Comment: Another Field of another RecordSet that this field references. This is the equivalent of a foreign key reference in a relational database.

Label: regex
Comment: A regular expression to apply to the data.

Label: repeated
Comment: If true, then the Field is a list of values of type dataType.

Label: sdVersion
Comment: The version of the dataset metadata, which may be distinct from the version of the dataset content.

Label: separator
Comment: A separator to use parse the data into an array.

Label: source
Comment: The data source of the field. This will generally reference a FileObject or FileSet's contents (e.g., a specific column of a table).

Label: subField
Comment: Another Field that is nested inside this one.

Label: transform
Comment: A transformation to apply on source data on top of the extracted method as specified through extract, e.g., a regular expression or JSON query.

Label: unArchive
Comment: Extract the content of the archive.

Label: value
Comment: An optional constant value for the field.

Label: distribution
Comment: By contrast with schema.org/Dataset, Croissant requires the distribution property to have values of type FileObject or FileSet.
